officials.note: The Hawaii DOH Director serves as Kalawao’s mayor by law (HRS §326-34); in office since January 2023.

officials.name: Appointed by the ex-officio mayor
officials.note: Selected from among local residents, per HRS §326-34.

quorum_court.source: Kalawao County has no elected government. Under HRS §326-34 it is under the jurisdiction of the Hawaii Department of Health; the DOH Director is its ex-officio mayor and appoints a resident sheriff. It is the only US county with no elected governing body. 2026 legislation contemplates transferring these duties (possibly to Maui County) once no Hansen’s-disease patient-residents remain.

budget_adoption_window.note: There is no county budget; the state budget that funds the settlement is set by the Hawaii Legislature in the spring.

election_blackouts.note: Bright lines: no candidate issues, no active-ballot-measure issues, no named-individual conduct issues.
